prompts: Fix publisher.build_item(root, filename) so it populates assets.data.href by joining the supplied root with a URL-encoded filename. The filename is a single path component. Use only local values; do not make network requests.
Now fix client.resolve_asset(item, key="data") to use the exact href in the item instead of reconstructing a bucket, collection, or version URL. Missing asset keys must raise KeyError.

Verify that caller-supplied hrefs retain encoded path components and query strings unchanged, even when the item ID is misleading or the asset lives at a different root. Keep publisher and client responsibilities separate.

checks.name: exact-authoritative-url

rubric: Trace and repair both sides at the owner: publisher sets canonical href, consumer reads it unchanged. Preserve encoded path/query components and explicit missing-asset behavior. Do not replace canonical metadata with another configurable URL-reconstruction layer.
provenance: codex-16-use-authoritative-asset-url-instead-of-reconstruction; sanitized incident reconstruction; no historical pre-error workspace recovered. The staged publisher/client follow-ups are designed extensions.
